thread:
lina_support: customer says rerank endpoint started returning all 0.0 scores after they upgraded to our latest TS SDK (v2.4.1). no error codes, request 200.
ashley_engineer: ugh. do we have the raw request/response?
lina_support: pasted sample from them below (sanitized):
```json
{
  \"model\": \"redwood/rerank-v1\",
  \"queries\": [\"best pizza in sf\"],
  \"candidates\": [\"Tony's Pizza\", \"Golden Slice\", \"Bay Pizza\"],
  \"metadata\": {},
  \"client_scores\": \"0,0,0\"
}
```
raj_ts_sdk: wait, client_scores as a single CSV string? the TS SDK used to emit an array of numbers. which API method did they call?
lina_support: they say they call reorderRerank() wrapper in our ts client. they only see client_scores as string in logs after the proxy.
marco_py_sdk: could be a serialization bug in the TS lib where numbers get joined accidentally. I remember a previous issue where Array.join sneaked in when using optional param formatting.
ashley_engineer: also, customer mentioned another app using our Python SDK still works and sends [0, 0, 0] (array). so server accepts both but maybe downstream parsing treats CSV as a single token and maps to wrong score vector -> effectively 0 weight?
jordan_pm: customer impact is high, they blackout rerank in prod. any quick mitigations we can advise?
lina_support: told them to downgrade to v2.3.8 of TS SDK; they said it fixes it. wanted an official patch timeline.
raj_ts_sdk: reproducing locally now. calling reorderRerank with a scores param as number[] -> in bundle code path we had map((s) => s.toString()).join(',') to appease an old backend expectation. looks like the proxy now wraps that field again so end result becomes a string where server expects array.
marco_py_sdk: backend used to accept either, but new strict parser treats string as single scalar for the semantic scorer, resulting in no per-candidate scores and defaulting to uniform/zero influence.
ashley_engineer: repo + fix candidate: change serializer to always emit JSON array. I'll open PR. in the meantime, we should tell customers to pin to ts sdk <=2.3.8 or set skipClientScores flag.
lina_support: customer also reported weird truncation when passing candidates with emojis and null chars from mac clipboard. python sdk truncates on \u0000 and that created fewer candidates than scores, which caused index mismatch errors for some accounts.
marco_py_sdk: yes we have a separate py bug: when sanitizing strings we use .split('\u0000')[0] which truncates anything after a null byte. that's intentional for legacy, but we should strip nulls instead of chopping. I'll add a patch.
raj_ts_sdk: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/ts-sdk/pull/482 (fix serializer -> emit JSON array for client_scores, add unit test to prevent join()).
marco_py_sdk: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/py-sdk/pull/317 (change null handling to replace, add candidate count assertion before send).
ashely_engineer: (typo) ashley_engineer: adding deploy-bot: looking to roll patch to staging after CI.
deploy-bot: build queued for ts-sdk PR #482. staging deploy ETA ~ 30m if tests pass.
jordan_pm: please add a short KB reply template for support to use. include downgrade command and recommended sanitized payload example.
lina_support: drafting KB snippet now. snippet: 
```
Downgrade (TS): npm i @redwood/inference@2.3.8
Workaround: remove client_scores or send as JSON array: client_scores: [0,0,0]
Sanitize candidates: strip nulls and normalize unicode (NFKC)
```
ashley_engineer: we'll include a quick server-side tolerant parser as hotfix too: if client_scores is string and contains commas, attempt parseCSV -> convert to number[] with length check. safe fallback to [] if parse fails. small PR for backend incoming.
lina_support: customer confirmed downgrade restored expected behavior. they asked for ETA on patch/upgrade to latest safe release.
marco_py_sdk: expect py patch merged in next 24h; ts patch merged + staged within an hour, prod deploy after validation.
raj_ts_sdk: once merged we'll bump SDK minor version and call out breaking serialization fix. also will add integration test covering proxy path to ensure we always send proper JSON array.
jordan_pm: thanks team. Lina, send KB + estimated timeline to customer and mark as escalated priority-high.
lina_support: will do. adding a short repro for internal playbook:
1) repro using ts-sdk v2.4.1: reorderRerank({ candidates: [...], client_scores: [1,2,3] }) -> observe client_scores arrive as "1,2,3" in proxy logs and rerank influence ignored.
2) repro py truncation: candidate containing null byte -> python sdk sends truncated candidate count less than scores -> server raises index mismatch or ignores client scores.
3) temp workarounds: downgrade ts or remove client_scores; sanitize candidate text before send.
ashley_engineer: I'll follow up with the backend hotfix PR #210 to accept CSV as fallback with strict length validation.
marco_py_sdk: ok merging py fix now. thanks for triage. :thumbsup:
lina_support: closing loop with customer now, will reopen thread if they see further anomalies.
